content: Be like the cliff against which the waves continually break; but it stands firm and tames the fury of the water around it.
author: Marcus Aurelius
story:
Rather than offering a polite platitude, this observation challenges how we navigate our inner lives. Loneliness is the painful ache of feeling incomplete, while solitude is the rich discovery of your own inner presence. In a world full of constant stimulation and notifications, being alone with your thoughts can feel intimidating.

Across his life and work, Marcus Aurelius saw how easily we surrender our tranquility to fear, vanity, and distraction. Yet silence is the only space where you can hear what your life is actually trying to say to you. When you make peace with quiet, you stop running to distractions to save you from yourself.
reflectionPrompt: What current difficulty or obstacle are you facing that could become your greatest training ground?
